title: Development of oculomotor digital biomarkers using clinical examinations as “Ground Truth”
authors: Trotter, Hunfalvay, Murray, Mathews, Carrick
summary_en: Compares six computerized oculomotor tests with clinician-administered examinations.
summary_zh: 对照临床眼动检查，评估六项计算机眼动测试的效度。

title: Improved reading and academic performance: A case series of 3 dyslexic students with learning disability
authors: Johnson Shen-Fung Huang
summary_en: Describes reading and learning outcomes during multimodal intervention in three students with dyslexia.
summary_zh: 通过三名阅读障碍学生的病例，讨论综合干预期间的阅读与学习表现。

title: Eyes on the prize: linking oculomotor behavior to match performance in collegiate women’s soccer
authors: Kinney, Smith, Hunfalvay, Murray, Rider
summary_en: Examines associations between oculomotor behavior and match performance in collegiate women's soccer.
summary_zh: 考察大学女子足球运动员的眼动行为与比赛表现之间的关系。

title: Age- and Sex-Based Developmental Biomarkers in Eye Movements
authors: Carrick, Hunfalvay, Bolte, Azzolino, Abdulrahman, Hankir, Antonucci, Al-Rumaihi
summary_en: Examines age- and sex-related variation in eye movements as developmental markers.
summary_zh: 分析年龄和性别相关的眼动变化，探索发育指标。

title: Eye Movement Differences in Contact Versus Non-Contact Olympic Athletes
authors: Murray, Hunfalvay, Mesagno, Trotter, Monsma, Greenstein, Carrick
summary_en: Compares eye movement characteristics of Olympic athletes in contact and non-contact sports.
summary_zh: 比较接触性与非接触性项目奥运运动员的眼动特征。

title: Age-Based Developmental Biomarkers in Eye Movements: A Retrospective Analysis Using Machine Learning
authors: Hunfalvay, Bolte, Singh, Greenstein, Murray, Carrick
summary_en: Uses machine learning to examine age-related eye movement patterns in 45,696 participants.
summary_zh: 使用机器学习分析 45,696 名参与者的眼动数据，研究生命周期中的年龄相关变化。

title: Reliability and Validity of a 9-Point Ocular Alignment Test of Cardinal Gaze using Eye Tracking
authors: Hunfalvay, Kopolow, Murray
summary_en: Assesses test-retest reliability of a nine-position eye alignment test and compares it with the cover test.
summary_zh: 将九点眼位追踪测试与遮盖试验比较，并评估重测信度。

title: Automated Eye Tracking Enables Saccade Performance Evaluation of Patients with Concussion History
authors: Song, Gabriel, Mohiuddin, Whitaker, Wisely, Kim (Duke Eye Center)
summary_en: Retrospectively examines automated saccade testing in patients with a history of concussion.
summary_zh: 回顾分析有脑震荡史患者的自动眼动检查，关注扫视速度、准确性和注视。

title: The Effects of Chiropractic Craniopathy upon TBI Patients Measured by Eye Saccades
authors: Unger, Joseph F Jr.
summary_en: Reports pre- and post-intervention saccade measurements in four participants with a history of traumatic brain injury.
summary_zh: 记录四名有脑外伤史参与者干预前后的扫视测量，作为病例研究资料。

title: Long-Term Effects of Low-Level Blast Exposure and High-Caliber Weapons Use in Military Special Operators
authors: Hunfalvay, Murray, Creel, Carrick
summary_en: Compares oculomotor behavior in military personnel with low-level blast exposure and controls.
summary_zh: 比较有长期低水平爆炸暴露经历的军事人员与对照者的眼动表现。

title: Developing Brain in Danger: Critical Periods of Vulnerability from In-utero to Adolescence
authors: Carla Cannizzaro; Miriam Melis; Sophie Laye (editors)
summary_en: Collects research on vulnerability during brain development from gestation through adolescence.
summary_zh: 汇集胎儿期至青春期脑发育脆弱性的研究，提供发育神经科学背景。

title: Alpha Desynchronization Increases During Dynamic Visual Assessments Within One Year of Mild Traumatic Brain Injury
authors: Warlick, Lawton, Breitbach, Hunfalvay, Murray
summary_en: Examines dynamic visual assessment and alpha-band activity following mild traumatic brain injury.
summary_zh: 结合动态视觉评估与脑电 alpha 活动，研究轻度脑外伤后的变化。

title: Eye-Tracker Outcomes from Static, Mobile, Virtual Reality Eye-Tracking Devices
authors: Murray, Trotter, Sandri Heidner, Herman, Hunfalvay
venue: Eye Tracking: Background, Methods, and Applications · Neuromethods 183
summary_en: Discusses stationary, mobile and VR eye trackers in study design, data collection and analysis.
summary_zh: 介绍固定式、移动式和虚拟现实眼动设备在研究设计、采集和分析中的应用。

title: Oculomotor Behavior Predict Professional Cricket Batting and Bowling Performance
authors: Murray, Lawton, Rider, Harris, Hunfalvay
summary_en: Relates oculomotor testing to batting and bowling performance in professional cricket.
summary_zh: 将职业板球运动员的眼动测试与击球、投球表现进行关联分析。

title: Smooth Pursuit Eye Movements as a Biomarker for Mild Concussion within 7-Days of Injury
authors: Hunfalvay, Murray, Mani, Carrick
summary_en: Compares smooth pursuit in adolescents within seven days of concussion and age-matched controls.
summary_zh: 比较受伤一周内青少年脑震荡患者与年龄匹配对照者的平滑追踪。

title: The Pupillary Light Reflex as a Biomarker of Concussion
authors: Carrick, Azzolino, Hunfalvay, Pagnacco, Oggero, Arcy, Abdulrahman, Sugaya
summary_en: Retrospectively examines pupillary light reflex measures in relation to concussion status.
summary_zh: 回顾瞳孔对光反射测量，探索其与脑震荡状态的关系。

title: Visual Performance as a Function of Clear Central Aperture Diameter with a Defocused Myopic Periphery
authors: Kubota, Joshi, Samandarova, Oliva, Selenow, Gupta, Ali, Ciuffreda
summary_en: Compares reading, visual search and saccadic performance across central apertures and peripheral defocus conditions.
summary_zh: 比较不同中央清晰孔径和周边离焦条件下的阅读、视觉搜索与扫视表现。

title: Brain Vital Signs in Elite Ice Hockey: Objective Neurophysiological Reference Values for Concussion Management
authors: Carrick, Pagnacco, Azzolino, Hunfalvay, Oggero, Frizzell, Smith, Pawlowski, Campbell, Fickling, Lakhani, Arcy
summary_en: Develops neurophysiological reference data in elite ice hockey for concussion research.
summary_zh: 建立精英冰球运动员的神经生理参考资料，用于脑震荡研究背景。

title: Circular Smooth Pursuit Assessment and Neuronal Activity in the Alpha Frequency as Predictors of mTBI
authors: Breitbach, Lawton, Warlick, Hunfalvay, Murray
summary_en: Explores circular smooth pursuit and alpha-band activity as measures relevant to mild traumatic brain injury.
summary_zh: 结合圆形平滑追踪和 alpha 频段神经活动，探索轻度脑外伤的评估指标。

title: Oculomotor Training for Poor Saccades Improves Functional Vision Scores and Neurobehavioral Symptoms
authors: Nicholas P. Murray; Melissa Hunfalvay; Claire-Marie Roberts; Ankur Tyagi; Jason Whittaker; Cedrick Noel
venue: Archives of Rehabilitation Research and Clinical Translation
summary_en: Uses intervention and control groups to assess saccades and neurobehavioral symptoms before and after oculomotor training.
summary_zh: 采用干预与对照组的前后测设计，评估眼动训练后的扫视和神经行为症状变化。

title: Classification of Comprehensive Neuro-Ophthalmologic Measures of Postacute Concussion
authors: Feller, Goldenberg, Asselin, Merchant-Borna, Abar, Jones, Mannix, Kawata, Bazarian
summary_en: Evaluates neuro-ophthalmologic measures for classifying postacute concussion in an athlete cohort.
summary_zh: 在运动员队列中比较神经眼科测量，研究脑震荡后的分类表现。

title: Fixation Stability as a Biomarker for Differentiating Mild Traumatic Brain Injury from Age-Matched Controls in Pediatrics
authors: Hunfalvay, Murray, Carrick
summary_en: Compares fixation stability in pediatric mild traumatic brain injury and age-matched controls.
summary_zh: 比较儿童轻度脑外伤患者与年龄匹配对照者的注视稳定性。

title: Head Position and Posturography: A Novel Biomarker to Identify Concussion Sufferers
authors: Carrick, Pagnacco, Hunfalvay, Azzolino, Oggero
summary_en: Studies postural stability across head positions in concussion-related balance assessment.
summary_zh: 研究不同头位下的姿势稳定性，提供脑震荡相关平衡评估资料。

title: Oculomotor Behavior as a Biomarker for Differentiating Pediatric Patients With Mild Traumatic Brain Injury and Age-Matched Controls
authors: Hunfalvay, Murray, Roberts, Tyagi, Barclay, Carrick
summary_en: Compares oculomotor behavior in pediatric mild traumatic brain injury and age-matched controls.
summary_zh: 比较儿童轻度脑外伤患者与对照者的眼动行为指标。

title: Visual and Oculomotor Abilities Predict Professional Baseball Batting Performance
authors: Liu, Edmunds, Burris, Appelbaum
venue: Int. Journal of Performance Analysis in Sport
summary_en: Relates preseason visual and oculomotor assessments to professional baseball batting performance.
summary_zh: 结合季前视觉与眼动测试及赛季数据，研究职业棒球击球表现。

title: A Comparison of Cardinal Gaze Speed Between Major League Baseball Players, Amateur Prospects, and Nonathletes
authors: Kubitz, Roberts, Hunfalvay, Murray
venue: Journal of Sports and Performance Vision
summary_en: Compares cardinal gaze speed among Major League Baseball players, amateur prospects and non-athletes.
summary_zh: 比较职业棒球运动员、业余新秀与非运动员向主要注视方向转移目光的速度。

title: Vertical smooth pursuit as a diagnostic marker of traumatic brain injury
authors: Hunfalvay, Roberts, Murray, Tyagi, Barclay, Bolte, Kelly, Carrick
summary_en: Compares vertical smooth pursuit across traumatic brain injury severity groups and healthy controls.
summary_zh: 比较不同脑外伤严重程度组与健康对照者的垂直平滑追踪。

title: Visual Assessments Predict Swing Propensity in Professional Baseball
authors: Edmunds, Liu, Appelbaum
summary_en: Explores the relationship between visual assessments and swing propensity in professional baseball.
summary_zh: 通过职业棒球数据探索视觉测评与挥棒倾向之间的关系。

title: Oculomotor Behavior of Acutely Concussed Patients undergoing Hyperbaric Oxygen Treatment
authors: Hunfalvay, Murray, Tyagi, Denham, Biberdorf, Wegge
summary_en: Reports oculomotor behavior during hyperbaric oxygen treatment in acutely concussed patients.
summary_zh: 记录接受高压氧治疗的急性脑震荡患者的眼动行为变化。

title: Horizontal and Vertical Self-Paced Saccades as a Diagnostic Marker of Traumatic Brain Injury
authors: Hunfalvay, Roberts, Murray, Tyagi, Kelly, Bolte
summary_en: Examines horizontal and vertical self-paced saccades in traumatic brain injury assessment.
summary_zh: 研究水平和垂直自定节奏扫视在脑外伤评估中的应用。

title: An Examination of the Oculomotor Behavior Metrics Within a Suite of Digitized Eye Tracking Tests
authors: Bolte, Kubitz, Roberts, Hunfalvay, Tyagi, Murray
summary_en: Conference report examining oculomotor metrics and normative values in a digitized test battery.
summary_zh: 会议报告讨论数字化眼动测试组合中的眼动指标及常模。

title: A Comparison of Visual Speed to the Cardinal Gaze Positions Between Major League Baseball Players and Amateur Prospects
authors: Kubitz, Roberts, Hunfalvay, Murray
summary_en: Conference report comparing cardinal gaze speed in professional baseball players and amateur prospects.
summary_zh: 会议报告比较职业棒球运动员与业余新秀的主要注视方向转移速度。

title: An Examination of the Oculomotor Behavior Metrics Within a Suite of Digitized Eye Tracking Tests
authors: Murray, Kubitz, Roberts, Hunfalvay, Bolte, Tyagi
summary_en: Examines reliability, normative values and age-group differences in digitized eye-tracking tests.
summary_zh: 评估数字化眼动测试的信度、常模及年龄组间差异。

title: The Effect of Prior Tennis Experience on Wheelchair Tennis Players’ Visual Search
authors: Hunfalvay, Murray
summary_en: Examines how prior biped tennis experience relates to visual search in wheelchair tennis.
summary_zh: 研究既往站立网球经验与轮椅网球运动员视觉搜索策略的关系。

title: Interpupillary Distance and Pupil Diameter of Baseball Athletes and Non-Athletes
authors: Hunfalvay, Kubitz, Murray, Tibbert, Bolte
summary_en: Compares interpupillary distance and pupil diameter in baseball athletes and non-athletes.
summary_zh: 比较棒球运动员与非运动员的瞳距和瞳孔直径。

title: Reliability of Computerized Eye-tracking Reaction Time Tests in Non-athletes, Athletes, and Individuals with Traumatic Brain Injury
authors: Lange, Hunfalvay, Murray, Roberts, Bolte
summary_en: Assesses reliability of eye-tracking measures of simple, choice and discrimination reaction time.
summary_zh: 评估简单、选择和辨别反应时眼动测试的信度。

title: Brain Monitoring Devices in Neuroscience Clinical Research: The Potential of Remote Monitoring Using Sensors, Wearables, and Mobile Devices
authors: Bill Byrom; Marie McCarthy; Peter Schueler; Willie Muehlhausen
summary_en: Reviews sensors, wearables and mobile devices for remote brain monitoring in clinical research.
summary_zh: 综述传感器、可穿戴设备和移动设备用于远程脑功能监测的研究方法。

title: Eye Tracking Technology for Clinical Practice: Benefits, Limitations, and Considerations
authors: Hunfalvay
summary_en: Editorial discussing clinical applications and measurement considerations for eye tracking.
summary_zh: 临床视角的社论讨论眼动技术的应用与测量考虑。

title: Applied Psychophysiology: Using Biofeedback, Neurofeedback, and Visual Feedback
authors: Smith, Hunfalvay, Herzog, Beauchamp
summary_en: Book chapter introducing biofeedback, neurofeedback and visual feedback in applied psychophysiology.
summary_zh: 书籍章节介绍生物反馈、神经反馈和视觉反馈在应用心理生理学中的使用。

title: An Exploration of Shifts in Visual Fixation Prior to the Execution of Baseball Batting
authors: Hunfalvay, Roberts, Ryan, Murray, Tabano, Martin
summary_en: Uses mobile eye tracking to examine fixation shifts before professional baseball batting.
summary_zh: 使用移动眼动设备观察职业棒球运动员击球准备阶段的注视转移。

title: The Reliability, Validity, and Normative Data of Interpupillary Distance and Pupil Diameter Using Eye-Tracking Technology
authors: Murray, Hunfalvay, Bolte
summary_en: Assesses reliability, clinical validity and normative values of eye-tracked interpupillary distance and pupil diameter.
summary_zh: 对照临床工具评估眼动设备测量瞳距、瞳孔直径的信效度与常模。

title: Lingering Binocular Vision Issues after a Suspected Concussion: A Case Study
authors: Hunfalvay
summary_en: Case study following binocular vision problems and vision therapy after suspected concussion.
summary_zh: 以单病例随访记录疑似脑震荡后的双眼视觉问题与视觉训练过程。

title: Evaluation of Stereo Acuity in Professional Baseball and LPGA Athletes Compared to Non-Athletes
authors: Hunfalvay, Orr, Murray, Roberts
summary_en: Compares stereoacuity in professional baseball, golf and non-athlete groups using a digitized test.
summary_zh: 比较职业棒球、高尔夫与非运动员的立体视敏度，并评估数字化测试。

title: Reliability and Normative Data of Computerized Dynamic Visual Acuity Tests
authors: Murray, Hunfalvay, Roberts, Lange
summary_en: Examines reliability and normative data for computerized dynamic visual acuity tests.
summary_zh: 研究计算机化动态视力测试的信度与常模。

title: Home-Based Therapy for Symptomatic Convergence Insufficiency in Children: A Randomized Clinical Trial
authors: Pediatric Eye Disease Investigator Group
summary_en: Randomized clinical trial comparing home computer therapy, near-target exercises and placebo for childhood convergence insufficiency.
summary_zh: 随机临床试验比较儿童集合不足的居家计算机训练、近目标训练和安慰剂方案。

title: Wearing Eye Tracking Technology during Batting Practice: Assessing the Experiences of Professional Baseball Athletes
authors: Roberts, Tabano, Hunfalvay
summary_en: Uses verbal reports to study professional baseball players' experiences of wearing eye trackers during batting practice.
summary_zh: 通过职业棒球运动员的口述报告，研究击球训练时佩戴眼动设备的体验。

title: A Comparison of Visual Search Strategies of Elite and Non-Elite Tennis Players Through Cluster Analysis
authors: Murray, Hunfalvay
summary_en: Uses cluster analysis to compare visual search strategies of elite and non-elite tennis players.
summary_zh: 使用聚类分析比较高水平与非高水平网球运动员的视觉搜索策略。

title: Treatment of symptomatic convergence insufficiency with home-based computerized vergence system therapy in children
authors: Huston, Hoover
summary_en: Retrospectively examines clinical measures during home computerized vergence therapy in children.
summary_zh: 回顾儿童集合不足病例，评估居家计算机集合训练期间的临床测量。

title: Convergence Insufficiency — A Major Review
authors: Cooper, Jamal
summary_en: Reviews convergence insufficiency, including its causes, diagnosis, sensorimotor findings and management.
summary_zh: 综述集合不足的病因、诊断、感觉运动表现与管理方法。

title: Treatment of symptomatic convergence insufficiency with a home-based computer orthoptic exercise program
authors: Serna, Rogers, McGregor, Golden, Bremer, Rogers
summary_en: Examines a home computer orthoptic exercise program for symptomatic convergence insufficiency.
summary_zh: 研究居家计算机视轴训练在有症状集合不足中的应用。

title: Reduction of Symptoms in Binocular Anomalies Using Computerized Home Therapy (HTS)
authors: Cooper, Feldman
summary_en: Retrospectively examines binocular vision symptom scores before and after computerized home therapy.
summary_zh: 回顾居家计算机训练前后的双眼视觉症状问卷结果。

title: Computerized Vision Therapy for Home and Office Treatment of Accommodative & Vergence Disorders & Amblyopia
authors: Cooper
summary_en: Discusses computerized vision therapy for accommodation, vergence disorders and amblyopia.
summary_zh: 介绍针对调节、集合障碍和弱视的计算机视觉训练。

title: The Role of Verbal Cues in Visual Search Behavior During Observational Learning
authors: Coker, Hunfalvay
summary_en: Examines verbal cues and visual highlights during observational learning using eye tracking.
summary_zh: 通过眼动记录考察语言提示与视觉标记对观察学习中视觉搜索的影响。

title: Characteristics of Expert Wheelchair Tennis Players According to Visual Selective Attention Preference
authors: Hunfalvay
venue: Research Quarterly for Exercise and Sport
summary_en: Conference abstract on visual selective attention preferences in expert wheelchair tennis players.
summary_zh: 会议摘要讨论优秀轮椅网球运动员的视觉选择性注意偏好。

title: Validity & Reliability of the Revised Convergence Insufficiency Symptom Survey in Children Aged 9 to 18 Years
authors: Borsting, Rouse, Mitchell, Scheiman, Cotter, Cooper, Kulp, London, CITT Group
summary_en: Evaluates validity and reliability of the revised Convergence Insufficiency Symptom Survey in children.
summary_zh: 评估儿童集合不足症状问卷修订版的信度与效度。

title: A Novel Approach to Training Attention and Gaze in ASD: A Feasibility and Efficacy Pilot Study
authors: Leanne Chukoskie; Marissa Westerfield; Jeanne Townsend
summary_en: Pilot study of home gaze-contingent games for attention and eye movement training in adolescents with autism. Eight enrolled and six completed eight weeks of training.
summary_zh: 面向自闭症青少年的居家注视响应游戏试点研究，训练注意与眼动控制；八人入组，六人完成八周训练。

title: Atari-HEAD: Atari Human Eye-Tracking and Demonstration Dataset
authors: Ruohan Zhang; Calen Walshe; Zhuode Liu; Lin Guan; Karl S. Muller; Jake A. Whritner; Luxin Zhang; Mary M. Hayhoe; Dana H. Ballard
summary_en: Pairs human actions with gaze during 20 Atari games. The dataset supports studies of visual attention, gaze prediction and imitation learning.
summary_zh: 提供二十款 Atari 游戏中的玩家操作与同步眼动记录，支持视觉注意、注视预测和模仿学习研究。

title: Eye-gaze-driven games to support oculomotor skills in young adults with cerebral palsy using eye-tracking technology: a multiple case study
authors: Cristina Costantini; Claudia Salatino; Roberta Daini
summary_en: A multiple-case study follows three young adults with cerebral palsy using four LookLab gaze games across five sessions. Pre/post visual assessments and usability observations examine the feasibility of game-based oculomotor practice.
summary_zh: 多案例研究让三名脑瘫青年在五次训练中使用四款 LookLab 眼控游戏，结合训练前后的视觉评估与可用性观察，考察游戏化眼球运动练习的可行性。

title: Effects of an Eye-Tracking Digital Serious Game on Cognitive Function in Mild Cognitive Impairment: Pilot Intervention Study
authors: Sang-Woo Lee; Jun-Su Kim; Seung-Jae Kim; Seungho Choun; Jeong-Heon Song
summary_en: Twelve older adults with mild cognitive impairment completed 12 sessions of an eye-tracking serious game. Cognitive screening and eye-movement measures before and after training provide pilot observations for further intervention studies.
summary_zh: 十二名轻度认知障碍老年人完成十二次眼动严肃游戏训练。研究通过训练前后的认知筛查与眼动指标，提供后续干预研究所需的初步观察。

title: Using Eye Tracking to Measure Video Game–Assisted Therapy for Improved Visual Outcomes in Pediatric Strabismus: Randomized Control Trial
authors: Ahmad F Klaib
summary_en: A randomized study of 30 children aged 5–10 compares patching with patching plus video games over three months. Eye tracking measures fixation stability as an outcome of the game-assisted intervention.
summary_zh: 随机对照研究纳入三十名五至十岁儿童，比较三个月的遮盖治疗与遮盖结合电子游戏训练。眼动追踪用于测量注视稳定性，评估游戏辅助干预的视觉结果。

title: Integrating virtual reality and eye-tracking as a gamified assessment tool for self-regulated learning
authors: David Vanecek; Inam Ur Rehman; Martin Dobias
summary_en: The VR Zoo environment combines game tasks and eye tracking to assess self-regulated learning in 103 students. In-game indicators of cognition, metacognition and motivation are compared with external assessments.
summary_zh: VR Zoo 将游戏任务与眼动追踪结合，用于评估一百零三名学生的自我调节学习。研究将游戏中的认知、元认知与动机指标同外部测评进行比较。

title: A Standardized Comparison of Blink, Wink, and Dwell as Selection Methods for Gaze-based Interaction
authors: Maria Francesca Roig-Maimó; Ramon Mas-Sansó; I. Scott MacKenzie
summary_en: A standardized two-dimensional pointing task compares blink, wink and dwell selection. Throughput, errors and user preferences help characterize selection methods and the role of cursor visibility.
summary_zh: 通过标准化二维指向任务比较双眼眨眼、单眼眨眼与停留选择，分析吞吐量、错误率及使用偏好，为眼控界面的选择方式与光标显示提供设计参考。

title: The People's Gaze: Co-Designing and Refining Gaze Gestures with Users and Experts
authors: Yaxiong Lei; Xinya Gong; Shijing He; Yafei Wang; Mohamed Khamis; Juan Ye
summary_en: Four co-design workshops with 20 participants generated 102 gaze-gesture concepts. Expert refinement produced a set of 32 gestures, exploring how gaze movement, dwelling and blinking can express intentional commands.
summary_zh: 二十名参与者在四场共创工作坊中提出一百零二个注视手势概念，再由专家整理为三十二种手势，探索视线移动、停留与眨眼如何表达主动操作意图。

title: HiFiGaze: Improving Eye Tracking Accuracy Using Screen Content Knowledge
authors: Taejun Kim; Vimal Mollyn; Riku Arakawa; Chris Harrison
summary_en: HiFiGaze uses knowledge of displayed screen content together with its reflection in the eye to support gaze estimation. The work evaluates this additional visual signal as a way to improve camera-based eye tracking.
summary_zh: HiFiGaze 将已知屏幕内容与眼睛中的屏幕反射结合用于视线估计，评估这种附加视觉信号对摄像头眼动追踪精度的作用。

title: Mapping Eye-Tracking Research in Human–Computer Interaction: A Science-Mapping and Content-Analysis Study
authors: Adem Korkmaz
summary_en: A bibliometric analysis maps 1,033 HCI eye-tracking publications from 2020–2025, with content analysis of 50 highly cited papers. It organizes research themes, methods and collaboration patterns across the field.
summary_zh: 研究对二〇二〇至二〇二五年的一千零三十三篇人机交互眼动文献进行计量分析，并深入分析五十篇高被引论文，梳理研究主题、方法与合作网络。

title: Skills-Transfer and Gaze Strategies Studied by Eye-Tracking: A Systematic Review
authors: Elena Lupia; Alessandro Bortolotti; Riccardo Palumbo
summary_en: A systematic review examines gaze strategies and skill transfer across training domains. It considers expert gaze demonstrations and visual cues as ways to guide learners’ attention during practice.
summary_zh: 系统综述梳理不同训练领域中的注视策略与技能迁移，关注专家视线示范和视觉提示如何引导学习者在练习中的注意分配。

title: Mnemonic Tracing: Using Eye Gaze to Search for Visual Memories
authors: Wazeer Zulfikar; Yasith Samaradivakara; Paul Pu Liang; Pattie Maes
summary_en: An exploratory study asks 11 participants to trace remembered images with their gaze on an empty space. The system uses these gaze traces to retrieve candidates from a set of 30 images, exploring a memory-driven search interface.
summary_zh: 探索性研究让十一名参与者在空白区域用视线描绘记忆中的图像，再依据眼动轨迹从三十幅图像中检索候选结果，探索以视觉记忆为线索的搜索界面。

title: Anticipation Before Action: EEG-Based Implicit Intent Detection for Adaptive Gaze Interaction in Mixed Reality
authors: Francesco Chiossi; Elnur Imamaliyev; Martin Bleichner; Sven Mayer
summary_en: A study with 28 participants combines EEG and eye tracking during mixed-reality observation and selection tasks. Anticipatory brain signals are examined as cues for adapting gaze interaction to users’ intended actions.
summary_zh: 研究让二十八名参与者完成混合现实中的观察与选择任务，同步采集脑电与眼动，考察预期相关脑信号如何帮助注视交互适应用户的操作意图。

title: Personalized Inhibition Training with Eye-Tracking: Enhancing Student Learning and Teacher Assessment in Educational Games
authors: Abdul Rehman; Ilona Heldal; Diana Stilwell; Paula Costa Ferreira; Jerry Chun-Wei Lin
summary_en: This preprint studies eye movements in ReStroop, a recycling-themed inhibition-training game. Area-of-interest fixations and attention distribution across three difficulty levels support analysis of learning and teacher-facing assessment.
summary_zh: 这篇预印本研究回收分类抑制训练游戏 ReStroop 中的眼动，分析三个难度下兴趣区注视与注意分布，为学习过程分析和教师评估提供依据。

title: Improving novice performance in first-person shooter games: Using the biofeedback training focused on gaze movement
authors: Inhyeok Jeong; Daisuke Shimane; Akinori Takeda; Masaki Takeda
summary_en: A preprint compares gaze biofeedback training and a control condition in 19 novice FPS players. Twelve sessions over five weeks use auditory feedback when gaze moves away from the screen center, alongside game-performance measures.
summary_zh: 这篇预印本在十九名 FPS 新手中比较眼动生物反馈训练与对照条件，五周内开展十二次练习，在视线偏离屏幕中央时提供声音反馈，并记录游戏表现。

title: GlintMarkers: Gaze-Anchored Spatial Perception Using Corneal Reflections
authors: Seungjoo Lee; Vimal Mollyn; Chris Harrison; Justin Chan; Mayank Goel
summary_en: GlintMarkers combines an inward-facing eye camera with passive retroreflective markers. Corneal reflections support object identification and estimates of relative orientation and distance for gaze-anchored spatial interaction.
summary_zh: GlintMarkers 将朝向眼睛的摄像头与被动回归反射标记结合，通过角膜反射识别物体并估计相对朝向和距离，探索以注视为中心的空间交互。

title: Stretch Gaze Targets Out: Experimenting with Target Sizes for Gaze-Enabled Interfaces on Mobile Devices
authors: Omar Namnakani; Yasmeen Abdrabou; Jonathan Grizou; Mohamed Khamis
summary_en: This study examines target size in mobile gaze-enabled interfaces. Selection performance and usability inform the design of touch-free targets and dwell-based interaction on small screens.
summary_zh: 研究考察移动设备眼控界面中的目标尺寸，通过选择表现与可用性评估，为小屏幕上的免触摸目标和停留交互提供设计依据。

title: Enhancing Smartphone Eye Tracking with Cursor-Based Interactive Implicit Calibration
authors: Chang Liu; Xiangyang Wang; Chun Yu; Yingtian Shi; Chongyang Wang; Ziqi Liu; Chen Liang; Yuanchun Shi
summary_en: COMETIC uses relationships between cursor movement and gaze during interaction to perform implicit calibration on smartphones. The approach investigates calibration embedded in ordinary cursor-guided tasks.
summary_zh: COMETIC 利用交互过程中光标运动与视线之间的关系进行智能手机眼动隐式校准，探索将校准融入日常光标引导任务的方法。

title: Eye movements and ocular biomarkers in mild traumatic brain injury: from oculomotor pathophysiology to diagnosis and prognosis
authors: Ioannis Mavroudis; Oindrila Das; Alin Ciobica; Dimitrios Kazis
summary_en: A narrative review examines saccades, pursuit, vergence and pupil measures in mild traumatic brain injury. It connects oculomotor physiology with diagnostic and prognostic research, including measurement standardization and longitudinal validation.
summary_zh: 叙述性综述讨论轻度创伤性脑损伤中的扫视、追随、集合与瞳孔指标，将眼球运动生理机制同诊断、预后研究联系起来，并梳理测量标准化和纵向验证议题。

title: Oculomotor markers of functional impairment in traumatic brain injury using simple and predictive visual tracking
authors: Shimrit Shani; Oren Kadosh; Yaron Sacher; Keren Cismariu-Potash; Yoram S. Bonneh
summary_en: Thirty patients in traumatic-brain-injury rehabilitation and 30 controls complete simple and predictive visual tracking tasks. Bedside eye-movement measures are examined alongside functional independence scores.
summary_zh: 三十名接受康复的创伤性脑损伤患者与三十名对照者完成简单和预测性视觉追踪任务，研究将床旁眼动指标与功能独立性评分结合分析。

title: Examination of Eye-Tracking, Head-Gaze, and Controller-Based Ray-Casting in TMT-VR: Performance and Usability Across Adulthood
authors: Panagiotis Kourtesis; Evgenia Giatzoglou; Panagiotis Vorias; Katerina Alkisti Gounari; Eleni Orfanidou; Chrysanthi Nega
summary_en: Seventy-seven adults complete a virtual-reality Trail Making Test using eye tracking, head gaze and a hand controller. Completion time, spatial accuracy, errors and usability compare the interaction methods across age groups.
summary_zh: 七十七名成年人分别使用眼动、头部朝向与手柄完成虚拟现实连线测验，通过完成时间、空间精度、错误和可用性，比较不同年龄组中的交互方式。

title: Tracking the athlete's eye: Comparing oculomotor metrics with non-athletes
authors: Clea P. Tucker; Beatriz Barragan; Arianna Soave; Nafiseh Ghoroghchian; William Pei
venue: Scientific Journal of Sport and Performance, 5(3), 516–529
summary_en: A study of 163 college athletes uses eight virtual-reality oculomotor subtests and compares results with a normative population. The work examines athlete-specific eye-movement profiles for interpreting performance assessments.
summary_zh: 研究对一百六十三名大学运动员开展八项虚拟现实眼球运动子测验，并同常模人群比较，考察运动员特有的眼动特征及其对表现评估的意义。
